Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — stakeholders + RACI confirmation

Hi Emma — great to meet today, thank you and Daniel for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we’re aligned on who owns what in the MAP. I attached a first-pass workbook (MAP-Orion-v1.xlsx) and added a short milestones tab.

Recap / priorities we heard:
- Primary use case: secure patient data summarization for clinical ops (low latency, strong audit trails)
- Must-haves: VPC deployment, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence for inference logs
- Target pilot: internal clinical cohort, 2-week validation window

Draft MAP highlights (please confirm owners):
1) Pilot kickoff (Milestone) — Target: Aug 16 2027 — Owner: Emma Rogers (economic sponsor)
2) Security & controls review — Target: Aug 9 2027 — Owner: security-team@orionhealth.com (security owner)
3) Legal / DPA review — Target: Aug 12 2027 — Owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood legal lead for contract redlines)
4) Engineering integration (VPC/KMS) — Target: Aug 2 2027 — Owner: Daniel Cho (Orion eng lead)
5) Validation & go/no-go — Target: Aug 23 2027 — Owner: Emma Rogers

Dependencies called out:
- SOC2 evidence export and retention policy (security team)
- Network peering window with cloud infra (2-3 business days once firewall rules are supplied)
- Legal review of DPA and pseudo-anonymization clause

Could you confirm the RACI for the four stakeholder roles (economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, engineering lead) and flag any timing concerns? If these owners look right, we’ll update the MAP and share a signoff column so we can lock the target close date.

Links & attachments: MAP workbook (attached) and a read-only copy on Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_map_orion_v1

Thanks — I’ll schedule the 30-min follow-up for next week pending your availability.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Hi all — thanks for the heads-up, Emma. Quick legal perspective and timeline:

- We can own Redwood-side legal review (as Jordan suggested) — I’ll take the DPA redlines. Typical turnaround for straightforward DPA edits is 3–5 business days after we receive Orion’s preferred language. If there are custom data residency clauses, add 2–3 business days.
- Please confirm whether Orion requires any specific audit rights beyond standard SOC2 (this affects redline complexity).

Action items for legal lane:
- Jordan: please upload the customer-proposed DPA draft and flag clauses that Orion wants changed (I’ll annotate the workbook)
- Emma: confirm whether your counsel should receive copies of our redlines, or whether you’ll consolidate comments through Orion procurement

Timing adjustments: given the infra holiday window Emma mentioned, I recommend we shift the engineering milestone to Aug 3 (rather than Aug 2) and keep legal target at Aug 12. If security returns their checklist by Aug 10 as indicated, we should still be able to hit the Aug 23 validation target.

I updated the MAP (Drive link) with the signoff and gating columns and added a legal comments tab. Jordan — please review the edits and confirm before we send a consolidated MAP to Orion for signoff.

Best,
Laura Bennett
